findings.current: 删除“{name}”？项目行将永久移除。其关联会话和会话记录不受影响。
findings.replacement: 删除“{name}”？该项目将被永久删除。其关联会话和会话记录不受影响。
findings.detail: 项目行 is a literal 'project row'; on a phone the reader sees cards, and in a destructive confirmation 行 can suggest only the listing row disappears. The object being destroyed must read as the project itself. The explicit 被 also makes the passive unambiguous.

findings.current: 从此项目中移除“{name}”？该里程碑将永久移除。项目的会话和进度行不受影响。
findings.replacement: 从此项目中移除“{name}”？该里程碑将被永久移除。项目的会话和进度记录不受影响。
findings.detail: 进度行 is a UI-row calque; the surviving thing is the project's progress record. 将被永久移除 is the clean passive in a destructive confirmation. The milestone name and the what-stays half are preserved.

The field marks the session that filed the work, not one that committed/submitted it. Core renders the same relay field as '由{ids}登记' (tui.projects.render.filed_by), and 提交 is the settled word for commit, so the fragment can read 'committed by'.

current_report_verdict.reason: The destructive delete confirm renders '项目行将永久移除' — a literal row calque that can read as only the listing row, not the project record. All 8 action codes x 3 kinds render naturally with no English; key/placeholder parity is clean.
